_about: CAMPFIX v1, read by Scripts/Zones/CampLights.cs (StreamingAssets first). NON-SHADOW point lights in world metres (no shadow option exists). A row is on only while the zones are live and the player is within activeRadiusM of it. layerMask 65535 = every light layer, so the runtime camp NPCs (Default layer only) and the player's rim-layer renderers are both lit. Candela at the fixed exposure EV 9.4 (look.json): about 1 / (1.2 x 2^9.4) = 0.0012 of white per nit; 3500 cd at 1.4 m is 1800 lux = about 0.02 of white on Arissa's dark leather (albedo about 0.04) and about 0.15 on skin. ARITHMETIC, NOT SEEN: tune by eye. Position: hangs from the awning frame 0.8 m in front of the trader (-3.7, 89.5), above the counter (x -2.65, top 1.05 m); kelvin 2200 = the door lamp (atmosphere.json DoorFlickerWarm), so no new colour in the palette. flicker = the FurnaceFlicker noise schema, small amplitude (a lantern, not a brazier). enabled false = no light, no code path.
